newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BCN prequalifies for Banerj sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BCN prequalifies for Banerj sale.

text.p: Brazilian private bank BCN has prequalified for the June 17 privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, a BCN official said.

Other already prequalified bidders are Bradesco, Banco Itau, General Electric's GE Capital, BankBoston Corp's Brazil unit, Credit Commerciale de France (CCF) do Brasil, Banco BBA Creditanstalt and Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana.
All of those seven investors prequalified last year when the Rio de Janeiro state attempted to sell the bank for the first time.

So far only Banco Itau has said it is interested and is likely to participate in the auction. Bradesco said it is still studying whether it would bid, while BankBoston in Brazil said Banerj is not of its interest.

Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana will not participate due to concerns that the new owner would have to assume future payroll-related debts, said Luiz Cesar Fernandes, president of Banco Pactual, which represents the company.
Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana is owned by a foreign bank.
Investors still have until Friday to prequalify, a spokesman for the Rio de Janeiro state said.
Rio's state bank, formally known as Banco Banerj SA, will be sold for 310 million reais at a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
